target_only_verification.construction: same common pre-update snapshot; target instruction and TARGET constraints only; no non-target instruction, topology label, coupling context, or non-target evaluator readout
target_only_verification.snapshot_rule: NO_UPDATE and REAL_REPAIR reset to identical common_pre_update_snapshot_sha256 for every repeat
target_only_verification.repair_rule: REAL_REPAIR uses exact frozen repair bytes; one repair_sha256 across all TO-V and later topology arms
target_only_verification.evaluator: existing AppWorld semantic target evaluator only

repeat_qualification.R2_rule: target disagreement rate <= 0.10 AND mean absolute CRR repeat difference <= 0.10
repeat_qualification.R3_rule: after one additional development repeat, target non-unanimous rate <= 0.20 AND mean CRR three-repeat range <= 0.20
repeat_qualification.hard_stop: if any metric exceeds 0.20, any technical unit is invalid, or R3 remains unstable; R>3 forbidden

precision_freeze.development_dispersion: max(full-sample SD, every leave-one-family-out SD) for family-level pooled UE and family-level HIGH-minus-INDEPENDENT UE contrast
precision_freeze.selection: smallest N candidate whose RQ1 and RQ2 planning SE are both <= 0.10
precision_freeze.if_N24_fails: STOP_PRECISION_QUALIFICATION; do not add families beyond reserve

panel_selection.selection: first N_star eligible family ids under frozen stable hash order

post_treatment_guard.still_effective_repair_claim: requires a prospectively specified panel-level target-gain inference; never family deletion
